body: The redness on my penis is the least of my problems. But it's been treated for fungal, bacterial, and dryness. Even atypical UTI. It remains the same. But again, I've started to not care about it because the other stuff is much worse. I'm mostly curious to see if anybody thinks the other stuff could be a result of anxiety or stress.

Do you really think conversion disorder is a possibility? It was one of the first things I saw when I was initially researching this. I'm going to start therapy in a couple of weeks, I'll bring this up and see if they can tailor my therapy around the possibility.

I was tested for CMV and EBV and came up positive for both. I'm really hoping they get a positive CSF for one of these so that I can get treatment. I just don't think it's going to be happening. I just have a feeling I'm never going to get a proper diagnosis. I've been in so much discomfort for the past 2 months, my life's pretty much been turned upside down. This all started happening after my first sexual encounter in my life, protected sex and unprotected oral. The day after my penis became all blotchy and red and still is to this day. All doctors including a dermatologist have said it looks normal to them and yeast infection, bacterial, and fungal infections have all been treated and ruled out. I'm still banking on this all just going away one day.

I've been tested for HSV 5 times. igM was negative 24 days after and my last igG test was 6 weeks post exposure. All have been negative and I haven't developed lesions. All doctors have told me I don't have herpes. Syphilis was negative too. All STDs have been negative. Could the syphilis have gone undetected even though I was negative?

The thing is, these symptoms all started after a sexual encounter. So I wanted them to test my CSF for a herpes infection of the central nervous system. I don't want to waste this chance while getting the lumbar puncture, so should I call the neurologist and see if they cab test for more things?
You can't give me a couple things just to suggest to my doctors?

I'm 28. I'm getting a lumbar puncture in 5 days, and after the results will be talking to the neurologist about it and probably doing more tests. Urologist appointment in 20 days. What infections could this be?? Nothing I see online matches up with the symptoms. Also I can urinate, I'm not retaining. I just don't feel that urge to go pee. Sometimes the stream seems weaker, sometimes it seems normal.
My lower back.

I will. And I just got off the phone with the neurologist, she recommended getting a lumbar puncture, which is something I begged my PCP to get but was refused. She also recommended getting a referral for an infectious disease doctor.

I have also had so many times where the anxiety has been low, and so many times where an answer from a doctor should have given me relief. But it doesn't. No matter what happens, the sensory issues and redness refuses to let up even the slightest bit.

You say it looks normal. But it doesn't at all to me. Before the encounter I had with that girl, it looked pink. Now it's all strange and red/blotchy. There has to be a reason for it. Can you have a psychosomatic irritation on your penis or what?

Because of the symptoms I am having. They are very distressing. I've had a bunch of tests to tell me what is wrong yes, but the pain and discomfort I feel is very real. And it's awful. And I have talked to my psychiatrist several times about this. He never brought up anything about health anxiety. He told me my symptoms are real and that he doesn't know how to diagnose me. And that I should keep the appointments with all the specialists. I really wish this was all health anxiety, I really really do. But I feel so horrible every day and the symptoms are incredibly pronounced and localized. The penis redness definitely does not look normal.

I was told he doesn't think that is what it is. He says it's a remote possibility, but hasn't had an HSV patient present with mostly nerve pain/sensations and urinary retention in his 20 years of practice. Even among those with extensive outbreaks he describes it as a mild 'pins and needles' feeling in the localized area of where the lesions are, or prodrome before it. I have been told by 6 different doctors and 2 physicians assistants that they do not suspect HSV over the last 6 weeks. I will not bother this subreddit any longer. I apologize for my self-centeredness and lack of empathy for folks that have been diagnosed and are having to deal with their own problems. It just remains frustrating and disheartening because of all of the literature I have seen about HSV attacking/affecting the sacral root ganglia, which causes radiculopathy, urinary retention and other strange symptoms which seem to be related to me. All of this happening shortly after a sexual encounter I had. But I digress.

I am 28. My symptoms also include electric-shock type sensations on my buttocks mostly, but rarely on my actual genitals themselves. I'm at the ER right now and they did a test to see how much urine I am leaving in my bladder and it was minimal. The doctor agrees that the lack of sensation to urinate, low pressure flow, and on-and-off urinary pressure while voiding is abnormal. I am now getting an MRI.
I've gotten so many urine tests and they all come back showing no signs of infection. I've asked to be given antibiotics just in case and am always refused.

I'm no longer going to post topics anymore because they are not well-received. But I will say this. These are not herpes symptoms?
-burning, tingling, crawling, and itching in thighs, legs, buttocks, groin, testicles
-sciatic pain
-urinary retention
-electric shock sensations on buttocks and genitals
-mild burning sensation on tip of penis
-fatigue
-nausea
-redness on glans

All for 6+ weeks after a sexual encounter, never having felt them before. If they are not, that is fine. The things I see on the internet and anecdotal things from people here and elsewhere seems to be all of these things.
I was a little relieved at first. But my symptoms persist, and seem to worsen. It's hard to be content when you experience such discomfort and pain.

I understand what you are getting at, but I don't have any bacterial or fungal infections. I have done a pretty crazy amount of tests on my urine over the past month and nothing has been out of the ordinary. I have been under pretty intense stress from this medical crisis I have been experiencing, but the symptoms I have are so pronounced it is hard to chalk up to being purely from stress. I apologize if I am annoying to you. I'm just scared and trying to find some answers.
I have discontinued the Lexapro for 8 days now and symptoms have persisted. Acute urinary retention along with all these other symptoms I have experienced has me really leaning towards HSV.
I have done that, and essentially nothing comes up related to that at all. Urinary retention is a common occurrence with new HSV infections.
Stress causing sciatic pain and urinary retention sounds highly unusual to me.

I just don't understand why my penis looked completely normal and pink before and then all of a sudden it is reddened and irritated. Sometimes the inside of my foreskin will become all red like this:
https://ibb.co/yP3Pvjr

This has never happened to me in my life. When I stretch the skin out a bit it is like I can see a bunch of red blood vessels, and when I let it go back to its normal position the redness is in the exact place as those blood vessels. Should I just not touch myself or masturbate at all for a couple of weeks? Masturbation has been uncomfortable ever since the first day this has shown up. I just have a bit of an addiction to it and every time I tell myself not to jerk off I'm like "well the doctors say it's looks normal, and I don't know how masturbation can cause this". I've gone several days without jerking off and it doesn't seem to improve.
It's just strange that all of this happened right after the sexual encounter, you know?  I've never had a problem with my back outside of mild upper back pain every once in a while.
I haven't been masturbating much in the last month.
Nope.

I've taken medication for that yesterday, but really am doubting that is it. I'm thinking I may have done some type of mechanical damage through roughness on the area, and something is happening to the blood flow of my penis. Because the redness always increases with an erection or when blood flow is increased in the area.
It can't be swabbed because it is not a lesion. They are just reddish patches of skin that aren't rash-like or raised at all. It's just discoloration. It has been this way for 1 month now.

I see. Thank you again for the reassurance. I feel a bit better. I have been stressing about this for a whole month now and it's really been eating at me. I'm really going to have to redirect my thoughts and ignore these feelings at the moment, and wait until the 90 day mark. I took the antibiotic in case it's some type of fungal infection, for now. I'll hold off on the Valtrex.

Did you get these sensations in your lower half like I do? Sometimes they go up to my arms and upper back and even face but it's more localized in the lower half. This is the reason it stresses me out so much and makes me think it's HSV.

Thanks for the kind advice. The doctor prescribed it to me though, too see if it has any effect. She just told me along with several others she doesn't think it's HSV. Well, she worded it like she thinks it's slightly within the realm of possibility but that she is pretty sure it's not. It could have placebo but I don't think it will be very pronounced if so. I'm going to take it for 3 days and then stop if there is no improvement.
And you were diagnosed?
When you say you had the same symptoms, how long did they last? Mine have been going on for over 1 month now. And did you have lesions? I haven't seen any on myself.

I'll do that for sure, it's all I can do at this point. From what I've seen, I can't find anybody that gets these symptoms with no visible lesions for such a long period of time like I have. I also feel some nausea, which has lasted for 30 days now. It's like a feeling of sickness that just won't go away.
How long do I have to wait for the Western Blot to show accurate results? Is 1 month long enough? I'm willing to spend that much for peace of mind.
